media.title: A FlowDeck agent exercises an app's core user flows

title: Let an Agent Exercise Core iOS Flows While You Work
summary: Daniel Bernal reports replacing fragile UI-test authoring for core app journeys with a FlowDeck agent that operates the app and checks those flows while he works elsewhere. The pattern complements unit coverage with delegated, observable end-to-end exercise rather than treating a successful build as proof that the experience works.
takeaway: Keep deterministic unit tests for logic, then give an agent a small set of named core journeys to exercise independently and require observable evidence before accepting the run.
